errors.text: The proposed Al intervention does not reconstruct the target 4.2 at.% Cr addition or the approximately 4 vol.% Cr2(Ti,Zr,Hf,Ta) Laves phase.
The baseline density and ductility are substantially incorrect: the target baseline is 10.44 g/cm3 with approximately 11.6% compressive fracture strain, not 12-13 g/cm3 and less than 5% elongation.

The density prediction is physically inconsistent: replacing refractory constituents with light Al would normally reduce, not increase, rule-of-mixtures density; the statement about Mo reduction causing a larger density increase is also backwards.
The predicted B2 volume fraction, reticulated morphology, and large ductility gain are not established by the cited evidence for this alloy system.
Uniform elongation is a tensile metric and is not the appropriate outcome for the specified room-temperature compression regime.
